leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom iterator object with a next() method that returns value-done pairs
Construct generator functions using the function* syntax and yield statements
Manipulate generator execution by calling next() and passing values back into the generator
Configure Proxy objects to intercept and customize fundamental operations on target objects
Apply Proxy handlers to control property access, assignment, and enumeration
Integrate generators with for...of loops to produce iterable sequences
Initialize Proxy with multiple traps to create reactive or validated data structures
